fighters.name: Harbinger of Decay with Doom Bell

abilities.name: Stream of Corruption
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 7" of this fighter and roll 3 dice. For each roll of 5+, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter and, until the end of the battle round, subtract 1 from that fighter's Toughness characteristic (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Thrice-ripened Death's Head
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 7" of this fighter and roll 2 dice. For each roll of 4-5, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter. For each roll of 6, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Toll of the Sonorous Tocsin
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Move characteristic of friendly fighters while they make a move action that starts within 7" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Venomous Sting
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a dice. On a roll of 2+, until the end of this battle round, that fighter cannot make move actions or disengage actions.

abilities.name: Spurting Mucus
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, each time this fighter is allocated a damage point by a melee attack action made by an enemy fighter, roll a dice. On a 3+ allocate 1 damage point to that enemy fighter.

abilities.name: Blighted Icon
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of visible friendly fighters while they are within 7" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Grandfather's Blessing
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee attack actions made by visible friendly fighters while they are within 7" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Rotsword Stab
abilities.text: This fighter can make a bonus melee attack action. If that bonus attack action scores any critical hits, roll a dice. On a roll of 4+, until the end of the battle, subtract 1 from the Move characteristic (to a minimum of 1) of the target fighter.

abilities.name: Unnatural Regeneration
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if there are no enemy fighters within 1" of this fighter. Remove a number of damage points allocated to this fighter up to double the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Impossible to Wound
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction when they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated to this fighter by each hit from that attack action (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Toll of the Doom Bell
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, enemy fighters cannot use reactions or abilities while they are within 7" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Disease-ridden
abilities.text: At the start of each battle round, you can pick one enemy fighter within 1" of one or more friendly fighters and roll a dice. On a 5+, that fighter cannot use abilities or reactions this battle round. Enemy fighters with this battle trait or the 'Infection Vectors' battle trait cannot be affected.

abilities.name: Draw Upon the Retchling's Power
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability once per battle.  This fighter makes a bonus attack action that has the Blast runemark.
